about: Recommended options of v67/dsinfer.py render_track_ds per bank. Measured on verse1, chorus1, verse2 (AI track of select_all_invaders, 168 BPM, robotic), plain and twinkle; three noise seeds each; see VERDICT.md.
engine: v67/dsinfer.py (imports v67/dspitch.py); DS(root, vocoder, threads, speaker), render_track_ds(ds, project, track, **options)

expr_by_style.rule: clip(expr[style] * (1 - 0.5 * voice.robotic), 0.5, 1); pass expr=None to get it

nishiren.name: Nishiren v2.1 (Gardanana)

options.seed: the track seed (per-phrase sessions are seeded from it and the phrase's first frame and length)

fixes.slow_motion: ON. Helps: verse1 WER tiny/base/small 0.507/0.387/0.296 -> 0.455/0.344/0.178, chorus1 base 0.18 -> 0.05; dropped syllables 3.8 % -> 1.5 %; cpp +0.9 dB. Smaller gain than on Qixuan.
fixes.voicing_floor: ON as a safety net only. No measurable effect on this bank (its variance model predicts a collapsed vowel in 1.5 % of verse1's vowels, 0 % elsewhere). Bank-specific fix for Qixuan.
fixes.pitch_predictor: ON. No effect on the words (inside the noise in all four cases); cpp +0.3 to +0.6 dB; outlier frames are bridged. Style choice, not an intelligibility fix, on this bank.
fixes.seeded_noise: ON. Renders repeat bit for bit, also across processes.

controls_measured_without_gain.velocity: 1.11 and 1.23 (README: 110-130 for fast songs): no effect; not a substitute for slow motion
controls_measured_without_gain.tension_off: +2: pressed tone (cpp +1.4, hnr -1.7), words equal; +4: worse; -2: breathier (cpp -2.9), words equal
controls_measured_without_gain.mode_Power: not better (small.en +0.09 on verse1, hnr -1.2 dB, level less even)
controls_measured_without_gain.min_vowel_0.04: removes the last dropped syllables in level, WER not better (0.02-0.08 worse); off

register.finding: The lead of select_all_invaders sits at A4-E5 (MIDI 69-77). An octave lower (transpose -12, same key) verse1 goes 0.436/0.379/0.167 -> 0.246/0.159/0.095 and chorus1 base 0.08 -> 0.01; 5 semitones lower 0.356/0.235/0.136. hnr falls 2.3-2.5 dB at -12 and not at -5. plain (C#4-A4) gains nothing from going lower.
register.recommendation: Write leads for this bank at or below about E5; for this song sing the AI lead an octave lower (transpose -12) or move the song down 5 semitones. A song-level decision, not an engine default.

nishiren.level: Output is 5-6 dB hotter than Qixuan's (verse1 -18.6 vs -23.2 LUFS, chorus1 -15.4 vs -21.7); peaks reach 0.91 of full scale in a phrase. Give the bank a gain of about -5 dB or normalise per track.

fixes.voicing_floor: ON. Helps (Q6 reproduced): whispered vowels 12.3 % -> 2.6 % of verse1, worst -36 -> -14 dB; with slow motion 0 %.
fixes.pitch_predictor: ON, with one known cost. chorus1 tiny.en 0.64 -> 0.35 (all three fixes); twinkle (pop, expr 1.0) loses about one word in ten on tiny.en and base.en (0.367/0.217 -> 0.450/0.350, six seeds), small.en equal.
